test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Even though Margaret had already eaten a large meal, she could not resist eating two slices of the __delectable__ pie.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'delicious.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

Let's look at the meaning of the given word:

 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 delectable
 looking or tasting extremely good, and giving great pleasure. (बहुत अच्छा लग रहा है या चख रहा है, और बहुत खुशी दे रहा है)
 
 

Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Stale
 no longer new or fresh, usually as a result of being kept for too long. (अब नया या ताजा नहीं है, आमतौर पर बहुत लंबे समय तक रखे जाने के परिणामस्वरूप)
 
 

 Delicious
 having a very pleasant taste or smell. (बहुत ही सुखद स्वाद या गंध होना)
 
 

 Nutritious
 containing many of the substances needed for life and growth. (जीवन और विकास के लिए आवश्यक कई पदार्थों से युक्त)
 
 

 Rotten
 decayed. (सड़ा हुआ)
 
 

 

 
• Clearly, the word 'delicious' is closest in meaning to the given word 'delectable.'
 
• Therefore, the correct meaning of the given word is option 2.
